hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.go|*/go.mod|*/go.sum|*/Makefile) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(make build 2>&1) || { printf "make build failed:\n%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ ! -f digitron ] || [ -n "$(find . -path ./.git -prune -o \( -name '*.go' -o -name go.mod -o -name go.sum -o -name Makefile \) -newer digitron -print -quit)" ]; then out=$(make build 2>&1) || { printf "make build failed:\n%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
